# Keep platform events outside calendar Redux state

The Bug 2061214 implementation report describes keeping platform event objects outside Redux, the draft state store, and rendering Save operation state through its observer. This preserves serializable state while exposing pending, failure, and success states to the dialog. Retain this separation when extending this Save controller. The report claims unit and browser coverage, but it is AI-reported evidence; later verification could not confirm matching binaries or complete runtime validation. It does not establish a Thunderbird-wide convention.

Scope: Calendar event Save state.
